detailed_description: Robots.txt Generator builds a plain-text robots.txt block from form fields. You can stack one or more rules, each with a single User-agent string and newline-separated Allow and Disallow path lists, plus an optional sitemap URL and an optional crawl delay (which is only emitted on the '*' rule). Four one-click presets fill the rules: Allow All, Block All, Standard (admin/api/private blocked), and WordPress. The output panel shows the assembled robots.txt and a Copy button sends it to the clipboard. The tool does not validate URLs against your live site, check rule conflicts, resolve wildcard precedence between bots, or download a .txt file.
usage_steps: Optionally click Allow All, Block All, Standard, or WordPress to load a starting preset
For each rule set the User-agent and edit the Allow and Disallow lists (one path per line)
Use Add Rule to add another rule block, or Remove to delete an extra rule
Enter a Sitemap URL if you want a Sitemap: line appended to the output
Enter a Crawl-delay number to apply it to the '*' rule
Read the assembled robots.txt in the output panel and click Copy to copy it
usage_examples: Start from the Standard preset and add a sitemap URL before copying the result into a new project
Build a Block All robots.txt for a staging site by clicking the Block All preset
Tweak the WordPress preset to also disallow a /staging/ path before copying it
Add a second rule block to grant a specific bot extra Disallow paths
